input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support

china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder adventure about leading settlers into the untamed frontier. Build and manage growing settlements, establish production chains and explore the world. Follow a story of gold rush dreams, dangerous encounters and the search for your family. They say the West is full of gold, hope, and vengeance. Most who follow the trail are chasing one of them. Most don’t find any! Will you? Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder where every sunset brings a new adventure. From timber to gold, from makeshift homes to bustling towns, you have to manage production and care for your people. Follow a story full of dangers while exploring the unforgiving frontier. Giddyup, Partner! As the leader of a group of pioneers, you are responsible for guiding your people as you expand into the untamed Wild West. Find the perfect places to establish new settlements and turn them into a home for you and your settlers. Build settlements across distinct frontier lands, each with its own resources and challenges. Explore the wilderness and claim new territories. Raise a Town Hall, lay down roads, build homes, keep the Saloon well supplied and watch daily life unfold across your growing frontier town. Create and expand production chains for food, building materials, tools, luxury goods, and more. Turn raw materials and resources into increasingly advanced products. Keep your settlers happy and give them a reason to stay. After all, you don’t want them packing their bags and going back to live somewhere else, do you? Everyone has a reason to head west: debt, heartbreak, hope, or... gold fever. But why did your father never come back? Beneath the struggle to build new settlements lies a personal journey to find him and keep the promise you made. Put on your cowboy boots, and head into the frontier with the people who followed you west. Learn their stories, worries, hopes, and dreams, as their lives become part of yours. Your choices have consequences. Surviving the frontier takes courage and guile, and every decision can shape your relationships and settlements. Experience the story through fully voice-acted dialogue performed by real actors. Hear the fear, anger, hope, and excitement behind the people who chose to follow you. The West is called Wild for a reason. The frontier you're about to explore is full of surprises, adventures and opportunities just waiting to be seized. Send your Scouts to discover new locations that you can explore, and chart your course westward! Will you find hidden treasures, strangers asking for help, a merchant from whom you can buy resources? You won’t know until you set out! Discover new locations and step into beautiful scenes where you can interact with the environment or meet the people who wandered there. Find new places to settle and keep your expansion moving. Travel the world to discover where your pioneers can set up their next camp. Settlers come west in search of a better life. Food and shelter may be enough at first, but a thriving town needs more. Keep your people satisfied, earn their trust, and they may help turn your settlement into a true jewel of the Frontier. Watch your pioneers go about their daily lives, use the spaces you create, and bring every corner of the settlement to life. Shape the town your way. Build roads and place buildings freely. Create the settlement to match your vision of the Frontier! Decorations add more than just charm. Fulfill your settlers’ wishes with benches, pets, instruments and other personal touches to make them feel truly at home. The journey through the Frontier is yours to shape. There’s always something worth pursuing. Choose which goals to follow, decide how to spend your rewards, and grow the town in the way that feels right. Take on Journey quests and use the experience you earn to unlock new buildings that shape your settlement’s growth. Set your own pace. The game adapts to your playstyle, rewarding progress toward personal goals without forcing you to follow the main storyline. Experiment with different specializations to find new ways to respond to settlements' needs. A note from the developer: Wild West Pioneers is being handcrafted with love by a small team of developers and artists who care deeply about the game. We’ve listened closely to your feedback and made some important changes along the way, including replacing all AI-generated assets with work created by our artists and re-recording the voice-over with real actors. We want to keep making the game better, so please talk to us, share your thoughts, and tell us what works and what doesn’t. Join us on Discord, be part of the journey, and let’s have a blast shaping the Frontier together. Saddle up, Partner. We’re only getting started. input.china_demand: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests. Heroes. Always barging in. Always swinging swords. Always acting like you’re the problem. In Packed Lair , you play as an evil lord trying to defend your very valuable underground real estate from an endless parade of so-called heroes. Draft buildings, rotate them into place, and squeeze every last bit of evil efficiency out of your cramped lair to create a monster army capable of keeping those meddling do-gooders out for good. Part Inventory Management, part Base Builder, part Roguelike Auto-Battler, Packed Lair is about squeezing maximum villainy out of limited floor space. Your lair may be small, but your ambitions are not. Every building you place can create minions, produce gold, improve your army, or unlock new ways to scale your evil operation. The trick is finding where everything fits. Rotate buildings, connect them carefully, and discover powerful layout synergies that turn a messy cave into a perfectly packed engine of villainy. Between battles, expand your lair, unlock new buildings, and adapt your strategy to whatever the heroes throw at you next. Each run gives you new buildings, new synergies to chase, and new opportunities to create the most absurdly efficient monster factory your tiny lair can contain. Once your lair is ready, it is time to let your minions do what minions do best: charge directly at the problem. Watch your goblins, shaman lizardman, dragons and other questionable employees clash with waves of increasingly determined heroes. Your army fights automatically, but you are not just sitting back and hoping for the best. Cast different spells during battle to tip the odds, disrupt the enemy, and turn a heroic invasion into a heroic mistake. input.china_demand: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. Unlock new military policies and weapons to enhance your troops' combat capabilities. Explore new areas, push the frontlines, and face stronger enemies! input.china_demand: A two-player co-op puzzle game with 30 challenging levels. Work together, solve puzzles, and practice deep breathing as your partner "figures it out." Do you like bad jokes, hard puzzles and have exactly one friend? Get ready to lose that one too. Solvimus is a two-player cooperative puzzle game made for best friends, brave duos, and sworn frenemies. Step into the sleek, chaotic labs of the I.N.T.E.L.L.I.G.E.N.C.E. Initiative (Institute for the Neurological Testing of Exceptional Logic, Looks, Intuition, Genius, Eloquence, Narcissism, Charisma, and Expression) - a suspiciously acronym-obsessed organization with a passion for testing minds… and friendships. This isn’t just a puzzle game - it’s a 10+ hour friendship test, packed with 30 intricate, teamwork-based puzzles across five mind-melting parcours. Whether you're solving laser logic mazes, mastering time manipulation, or shouting "WHY DID YOU DO THAT?" into your headset, every moment demands communication, coordination, and maybe a little therapy. 👥 Two Players. One Brain (Split in Half) Solvimus is strictly two-player co-op. Each puzzle is built from the ground up for dual-brain, dual-perspective problem solving. Alone, you're useless. Together, you're unstoppable. Or… stuck forever. 🧠 Explore Five Test Zones Each parcours introduces new twists and fresh mechanics: Dynamic Duo - The basics of betrayal. Trust-building... or breaking. Vertigo Venture - Gravity isn’t just a suggestion. It’s the enemy. Beam Bafflement - Lasers, mirrors, and mutual confusion. Hostile Havoc - Rapid-fire puzzles and environmental chaos. Chrono Conundrum - Time loops, paradoxes, and synchronized madness. 💬 Tools for Talking. Or Pointing. Or Screaming. Built-in voice chat so you can strategize or squabble in real time. Ping tool for moments when words fail or you're too annoyed to speak. 30+ emotes to communicate joy, despair, or smug superiority. 🏆 Climb the Leaderboard Complete puzzles efficiently and climb the Solvimus global leaderboard. Are you and your partner a well-oiled logic machine… or just really lucky? 🥚 Secrets, Surprises, and a Golden Prize Hidden within Solvimus is a mysterious Easter egg treasure hunt. Solve the riddles, find the secrets, and unlock a golden reward. ❓ FAQ Is the game splitscreen? No. Each player plays on their own device with their own view and role. Why is it not splitscreen? Because many puzzles rely on separate perspectives, asymmetric roles, and visual isolation. Splitscreen would break or limit the design. Do both players need to own the game? Yes. Each player needs their own copy of Solvimus and a stable internet connection to play together. Do you like bad jokes, hard puzzles and have exactly one friend? Get ready to lose that one too. Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner. During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses. china_opportunities.value: Starting with a table and a computer, create videos, build a following, secure brand collaborations, engage in live-streaming e-commerce, and assemble a team to ultimately establish your own media empire. Experience the journey of a content creator from obscurity to industry leadership! 关于这款游戏 从一名默默无闻的创作者开始，打造属于你的内容帝国。 《流量时代（Creator Era）》是一款像素风模拟经营游戏。 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 这些类型并不会被生硬地塞进游戏。它们更像一组帮助我们思考的坐标，使我们能够判断什么适合《阴阳界》，什么应该舍弃。无论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.武侠.、.生存.、.格斗.还是.收集.与.养成.，我们都希望大家能在这个世界中找到一个自然、清晰且不显得突兀的入口。 二、从经典传说出发，重新认识阴阳众生 《阴阳界》的世界由人、鬼、尸、妖四族共同构成。 人族并不总是正义，鬼族也并非生来邪恶；尸族可能保留生前最后的执念，妖族则可能比某些人更加重情。我们不想以简单的善恶标签概括角色，而是希望玩家通过剧情、羁绊和“文化志”，逐渐了解他们为什么站在这里，又为什么拔出手中的武器。 聂小倩与宁采臣的相逢，是爱情，也是命运的试探；青蛇、白蛇与法海之间的纠葛，则包含情感、规则和立场的冲突。这些故事中的人物会进入玩家的魂灵军团，却不会因此失去自己的性格。他们之间的情感联系将转化为羁绊效果，让剧情关系与战斗策略真正结合。 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 人族并不总是正义，鬼族也并非生来邪恶；尸族可能保留生前最后的执念，妖族则可能比某些人更加重情。我们不想以简单的善恶标签概括角色，而是希望玩家通过剧情、羁绊和“文化志”，逐渐了解他们为什么站在这里，又为什么拔出手中的武器。 《阴阳界》首要保证.牧場物語.的是.初露鋒芒.单人和挂机.鬼武者.体验，但.007.我们.戰鎚.也希望.龍之劍.逐步建立.arma.健康的.社交.与.多人联机.环境。 未来的魂灵竞技场会强调阵容博弈，而不是.三國鼎立.单纯.赤血沙漠.比较战力。我们从.dota.、.dota2.、.cs2.、.永恒轮回.和.皇室战争.等竞技体验中学习匹配、信息反馈和赛季节奏，但会根据卡牌游戏特点进行简化。 我们也研究过.互不侵犯条约.式联盟关系、.而离线参战.类减负机制，以及.洛阳争夺战.等大型活动的组织形式。虽然这些概念最初常见于战争策略游戏，但其中关于合作、外交和参与门槛的思考，同样适用于未来的阴阳阵营玩法。 玩家可能组成猎鬼小队，共同挑战.仙境傳說.高难首领；也可能加入阴阳势力，在赛季地图中争夺灵脉和古迹。部分玩法会强调.命令.与配合，让.反间计.、.神兵天降.、.白衣渡江.、.攻其不备.、.闪击.、.落雷.、.截寨.、.奔袭.、.水淹七军.、.声东击西.、.万箭齐发.、.一骑当千.、.全军突击.和.破甲.等策略概念转化为适合鬼怪世界的战术效果。 这些名称带有鲜明的历史战争色彩，因此在正式落地时，我们会重新.仙境传说.设计表现方式。例如，“反间”可能变成扰乱敌方魂魄，“落雷”可以由道门符箓召唤，而“神兵天降”则可能表现为阴兵借道。我们关心的不是.传说.名称，而是让玩家在有限操作中作出有意义的判断。 十、关于技术、性能与不同设备 《阴阳界》的厚涂美术、动态雾效和技能演出会给设备带来一定压力，因此性能优化是开发工作的重点。 我们参考.cod.、.mhw.、.obs.、.vrchat.、.repo.和.mir.等不同技术场景下的讨论，也研究过.ark.、.Rust.、.rust.、.dayz.、.scum.、.banana.、.wow.与.bg3.等作品可能面对的资源加载、多人同步和画面配置问题。 我们不会以牺牲基本可读性为代价追求特效数量。玩家可以根据.ark.设备性能调整阴影、粒子、角色精度和技能演出。中端设备应该能够稳定完成日常挂机.虹彩六號.与战斗，高端.sts.设备则可以.tbh.呈现更完整的.柏德之門.雾气、光影和材质细节。 在界面和交互方面，我们关注.palia.的生活感、.naraka.的动作.幻獸帕魯.信息、.hoi.的复杂系统展示、.kcd.与.天国拯救.的沉浸设计，以及.obs.相关场景中的录制与显示需求。我们会继续优化字体大小、色彩对比、按钮响应和战斗信息层级。 对于.卡牌录制.、.方言版.和.戰鎚.式厚重演出等玩家讨论，我们也会谨慎评估。未来若条件允许，部分角色可能加入符合地域和人物背景的方言语音，但必须以尊重、准确和容易理解为前提。 十一、怪诞之外，也要有人情与温度 《阴阳界》并不希望从头到尾都保持压抑。 在漫长的阴阳征途中，玩家也会遇到轻松、温暖甚至荒诞的故事。某只小妖可能只想找到回家的路，一名凶神恶煞的鬼差可能害怕打雷，而一位看似可怕的守墓人，或许数十年来一直在替陌生人照看一盏灯。 这部分内容会吸收.治愈.作品的陪伴感，也可能具有.牧场物语.、.Stardew Valley.和.时光杂货店.式日常温度。我们甚至讨论过.魂斗罗.、.超级玛丽亚.、.花札.、.棋牌.和.麻将.带来的共同游玩记忆，希望在不破坏世界观的前提下，为玩家准备一些轻松的小玩法。 对于喜欢趣味内容的玩家，.打倒白雪公主.、.勇者翻翻看.、.蠕行的恐惧.、.宇宙海盗.和.逃离鸭科夫.等名字所传递的反差感，也启发我们设计一些不那么严肃的支线。但这些内容不会变成毫无边界的恶搞，而会继续服务角色塑造。 我们还注意到.美女.、.屌丝.与.屌絲.等网络表达可能形成的刻板印象。在人物创作中，我们会尽量避免把角色简化成单一标签。无论是美丽的妖灵、平凡的书生，还是外貌可怖的鬼怪，都应该拥有独立人格，而不是仅仅成为取悦或嘲笑玩家的工具。 十二、我们对商业化与长期运营的态度 一款长期运营的游戏必须面对商业化问题，我们不会回避这一点。 但我们的原则是：付费可以提供更快的成长、更丰富的外观和一定便利，不能让免费玩家彻底失去获得核心角色、参与主要玩法及通过策略取得胜利的可能。 在设计过程中，我们研究过.4399.平台用户的轻量体验，也观察.三七互娱.、.心动网络股份有限公司.及其他团队在不同产品中的运营方式。我们还关注.至尊月卡.式长期福利、赛季战令和活动礼包可能给玩家带来的压力，并将“是否迫使玩家持续付费”作为重要评估标准。 我们不会把随机抽取包装成必胜承诺，也不会鼓励未成年人冲动消费。.赌博.和.德州扑克.式风险刺激不应该成为游戏的核心驱动力。角色获取概率、保底机制和重要资源来源都应尽可能明确。 签到、挂机、活动、主线、成就与赛季玩法都会提供稳定资源。玩家愿意长期投入时间，应该能够培养出属于自己的强力阵容。我们希望付费玩家觉得消费有价值，也希望零氪和低付费玩家拥有尊严、目标与成长空间。 十三、开发过程中的争论、失败和坚持 《阴阳界》的开发并不顺利。 我们曾经制作过一个过于复杂的五行系统，玩家需要同时计算时辰、天气、方位、属性和角色站位。它在设计文档里看起来很有深度，真正玩起来却像完成一道没有乐趣的考试，最终只能推倒重做。 我们也尝试过更加强烈的恐怖表现，但测试玩家反馈，持续刺激会让人疲惫。后来我们减少突然惊吓，转而通过声音、留白和环境细节制造不安。这个过程让我们明白，真正有效的恐怖不在于声音有多大，而在于玩家是否开始怀疑眼前看到的一切。 部分早期方案曾受到.刀劍江湖路.、.黑色沙漠.、.英勇之地.、.漫威爭鋒.、.光與影.和.仙劍奇俠傳.等不同作品风格的影响。团队必须不断提醒自己：灵感可以来自许多地方，但最后呈现的必须是《阴阳界》，而不是各种热门元素的集合。 我们也曾讨论.蘇丹的遊戲.、.苏丹的游戏.、.crab.、.ets.、.吞食天地.、.aoe.、.rivals.、.tes.和.kingdom.等名称所代表或引发的玩法联想。每次讨论结束后，我们都会回到三个问题：它是否符合中式鬼怪世界？它是否能为玩家带来清晰的乐趣？它是否值得玩家投入时间？ 只有同时通过这三个问题的设计，才有机会进入正式版本。 十四、建立真正属于《阴阳界》的角色图鉴 游戏未来会不断增加新的魂灵角色，但数量并不是唯一目标。 在历史与神话题材研究中，我们接触过.三英战吕布.、.虎牢关.、.吕布.、.赵云.、.典韦.、.关羽.、.马超.、.张飞.、.黄忠.、.许褚.、.孙策.、.太史慈.、.夏侯惇.、.夏侯渊.、.张辽.、.张郃.、.徐晃.、.庞德.、.甘宁.、.周泰.、.魏延.、.张绣.、.文丑.、.颜良.、.邓艾.和.姜维.等大众熟悉的人物。 我们也研究过.张让.、.张角.、.张宝.、.张梁.、.张举.、.张济.、.张邈.、.张昭.、.张鲁.、.张南.、.张松.、.张翼.、.张任.、.刘辩.、.刘协.、.刘表.、.刘禅.、.刘封.、.孙坚.、.曹操.、.曹仁.、.曹洪.、.曹休.、.李肃.、.杨修.、.马腾.、.马岱.、.马忠.、.马融.和.韩当.等角色的历史背景。 包括.鲜卑.、.乌桓.、.羌.、.山越.和.南蛮.在内的不同族群资料，也提醒我们：构建文化图鉴时，必须避免用单一视角把复杂历史简化成刻板标签。 这些三国人物不会直接成为《阴阳界》的主角，但研究成熟历史角色如何被大众记忆，能够帮助我们塑造聂小倩、宁采臣、白蛇、青蛇、法海、钟馗、黑白无常和其他传统人物。我们希望多年以后，玩家回忆《阴阳界》时，首先想起的不是某个战力数字，而是一个真正打动过自己的角色。 merged_final_input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support
